thread:
sara: Heads up, EU-west-1 canary shift started hitting 504s. New GPU nodes in az-2 are still provisioning :warning:

devon: Autoscaler shows pending pods waiting for capacity. Events: `scale-up: 0->2` but nodes never join the cluster.

mike: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` shows the new instances in Pending/NotReady: 
```
NAME                           STATUS     ROLES    AGE    VERSION
ip-10-0-12-34.ec2.internal     NotReady   <none>   2m     v1.28.1
ip-10-0-13-22.ec2.internal     NotReady   <none>   1m     v1.28.1
```

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary traffic shifted to `canary-v6` at 2024-03-14T09:12:34Z. Automatic fallback triggered after healthcheck failures.

anita: That fallback caused a brief burst to stable and a latency spike. Are we sure the traffic-splitter has capacity guards?

devon: Looking at the infra repo — terraform workspace `eu-west-1-prod` has nodepool config accidentally set to `max_size = 0` for the gpu pool (probable manual test left behind). Snippet: 
```
resource "node_pool" "inference_gpu" {
  name     = "inference-gpu"
  min_size = 0
  max_size = 0 # <-- oops
  gpu_type = "a10g"
}
```

kevin: I just pushed a limited `terraform apply` to bump `max_size` to 4 but held the plan for review (reserved capacity implications). Can manually scale existing on-demand pool to get the canary moving.

sara: Please don't merge reserved capacity until finance okays. For an immediate fix can someone scale the current on-demand replica set so the canary has headroom?

mike: Done — scaled inference deployment in eu-west-1 by +2 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=5 -n inference` — canary healthchecks are now passing.

devon: Long term fixes: add a pre-shift gate in the GitOps progressive delivery step that checks `available_gpu_capacity >= requested_tokens_threshold`. If check fails, abort shift and alert oncall. I'll open a PR.

anita: Also adding an alert to detect terraform workspace drift for nodepools and a runbook entry describing safe rollback vs reserved capacity request.

ops-bot: [alert] terraform-drift-detector: drift detected for `node_pool.inference_gpu` in eu-west-1-prod. New ticket created: INC-5123.

sara: Great. Summary/action items: 1) devon — PR for pre-shift capacity check; 2) anita — update runbook + drift alert; 3) kevin — follow up on reserved capacity approval; 4) mike — monitor canary for next 30m. I'll triage postmortem if this happens again. :thumbsup:
